Package aor.proj3t.entities

Class TwoFactorAuth

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.entities.TwoFactorAuth
@Entity public class TwoFactorAuth extends Object
Entity representing Two-Factor Authentication settings for a user. This entity stores TOTP secret keys and configuration for 2FA, maintaining a one-to-one relationship with the User entity.
